title: 🚨 SOMETIMES THE MOST HURTFUL THING YOU CAN SAY TO A GRIEVING PERSON SOUNDS “SPIRITUAL.”
paragraphs: 🚨 SOMETIMES THE MOST HURTFUL THING YOU CAN SAY TO A GRIEVING PERSON SOUNDS “SPIRITUAL.”
“Everything happens for a reason.”
“Just be strong.”
“You need to move on.”
“At least they’re in a better place.”
You may mean well.
But when someone has just lost a person they deeply love, they may not need an explanation.
They may need someone willing to sit beside them and weep.
📖 “Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.” — Romans 12:15
That is why I created:

HOW TO HELP SOMEONE GRIEVING A LOVED ONE
A Biblical Guide to Showing Up, Speaking with Grace, and Walking with Someone Through Loss
💔 WHY THIS BOOK MATTERS
Grief can make even good people uncomfortable.
We want to fix it.
Explain it.
Make the tears stop.
Say something profound.
But look at Jesus.
When Lazarus died, Jesus knew resurrection was coming.
And yet Scripture gives us two extraordinary words:
“Jesus wept.” — John 11:35
Jesus did not treat sorrow as an inconvenience.
He entered it.
And sometimes that is exactly what a grieving person needs from you.
Not a sermon.
Not an explanation for why God allowed it.
Not pressure to recover quickly.
Presence. Compassion. Prayer. Love. Hope.
This book will help you become that kind of person.
📚 INSIDE, YOU’LL LEARN:

• What to say when you genuinely don't know what to say
• What Christians should avoid saying to someone grieving
• How to comfort without trying to “fix” their pain
• How to listen when someone needs to cry, question, or simply remain silent
• How to offer practical help that actually makes a difference
• How to pray with grieving people without preaching at them
• How to respond when someone is angry, confused, or asking God “Why?”
• Why your support may be needed even more after everyone else goes home
• How to point someone toward Christ-centered hope without minimizing their loss
• How to walk faithfully beside someone through the long road of grief
Because grief doesn't disappear when the funeral ends.
Sometimes that is when the loneliness becomes even louder.
🔥 MOST PEOPLE SHOW UP WHEN THE LOSS HAPPENS.
Few remember three months later.
Most people search for the perfect words.
Few learn the ministry of listening.
Most people want to make grief disappear.
Few are willing to enter someone's sorrow and help carry the burden.
Most people say:
“Call me if you need anything.”
Few actually call and say:
“I'm here. What can I carry for you today?”
Which kind of person will you become?
⚔️ THIS IS BIGGER THAN ONE BOOK
It's about building a community of believers who want to know God's Word, live God's Word, and help spread God's Word.
If you believe resources like these should keep being created...
If you want to help us reach more people with the Word of God...
And if supporting this work is one practical way you personally want to honor God and participate in spreading His Word...
You're helping build something.
More biblical teaching.
More discipleship resources.
More Gospel-centered content.
More opportunities to put God's Word in front of people who need hope.
⚔️ THIS IS THE GOSPEL WARRIOR MOVEMENT.
We don't just consume the Word.

We learn it.
We live it.
Sometimes you cannot remove someone's pain.
But by the grace of God...
you can make sure they don't have to carry it alone.
— GOSPEL WARRIOR ⚔️✝️
